input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision (searches for "insurance" and "coverage" return nothing, and the single-article outline confirms no insurance clause). Kubient is a hosting/services vendor that collects, maintains and stores visitor information (data) and Customer Confidential Information (p0035, p0056), and indemnifies Customer for Service-related third-party Claims (p0047) with an uncapped liability regime. Without minimum coverage, those indemnity and data-security obligations are unsupported. We insert a short paragraph at the end of General Provisions requiring CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request; fallback is E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.

ops.text: (j) Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering Kubient's collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data) and Customer's Confidential Information; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short insurance provision in the General Provisions, as the Agreement currently requires no coverage from Kubient even though it hosts the Auction Platform and collects and stores visitor data and our Confidential Information. Our position is commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M and cyber of USD 5M, with certificates on request; we can discuss E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M if limits are an issue.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance paragraph (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' comp) in General Provisions.
